etymologies.etymologyHTML: Learned borrowing from Latin minimum, neuter form of minimus (“least, smallest”).

quote.citation: 2021 April 16, Judy Berman, “Kate Winslet's Mare of Easttown Is the Rare Crime Drama That Cares About Its Characters”, in Time‎[1]:
quote.text: Realism might be the hardest aesthetic to do well. The performances have to be genuinely moving and the setting vividly evoked; bonkers twists must be kept to a minimum.

definitions.definition: (astronomy) A period of minimum brightness or energy intensity (of a star).
(mathematical analysis) A lower bound of a set which is also an element of that set.
(statistics) The smallest member of a batch or sample or the lower bound of a probability distribution.
